question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Exceptional
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Outstanding**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Exceptional"** means something that is unusually good or outstanding. (असाधारण)
 
 
• **Example:** Her performance in the exam was exceptional, earning her the top rank in the class.
 
 
 
• **"Outstanding"** refers to something that is remarkably good and much better than average. (उत्कृष्ट)
 
 
• **Example:** His outstanding contributions to science earned him a Nobel Prize.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Outstanding**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Trivial** (तुच्छ): Of little value or importance.
 
 
• **Example:** The argument they had was over something trivial and unimportant.
 
 
 
• **Emotional** (भावुक): Relating to a person's emotions.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie was so emotional that it brought tears to my eyes.
 
 
 
• **Total** (कुल): Comprising the whole number or amount.
 
 
• **Example:** The total cost of the project was much higher than expected.
